limitations: Owners must atomically persist/check both identity namespaces, include all effect-relevant inputs in the fingerprint, validate provider key constraints, authorize submission and reconcile unknown outcomes.
The comparison guard is stateless and does not implement durable duplicate prevention, provider execution, retries, failover or business finality.
Engineering role reviews are performed by Codex; no independent human, Product or production acceptance is claimed.
ownership_note: The decomposition map is shared coordination metadata. This task updates only its P1-015 row; unrelated future row changes are not provider behavior changes.
acceptance_results: Owner command identity and explicit provider idempotency key are stable, opaque and exact.
Pure guard detects request/trace conflicts, provider key reassignment and owner retry key switching. DifferentIdentity grants no execution/failover permission.
ProviderObjectReference evidence is immutable, UTC-observed and attached only to the exact selected binding; empty evidence implies no outcome.
Existing command envelope and owner scope are reused without a second idempotency store, new package, public API/SDK type or provider call.
Existing canonical provider contracts and accepted ADR-0014 resolve the stale blocker. Historical P1-004 evidence is preserved with separately proven retrospective committed validation.
